data.name: Miranda
data.gender_notes: Miranda is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Miranda is derived from the Latin word ‘mirari’, which means ‘to admire’ or ‘to wonder at’. In Christian tradition, the name signifies a woman of great admiration and beauty, worthy of being marveled at. The name Miranda carries the meaning “Admirable, wonderful” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Miranda usually hope their child will grow to embody admirable, wonderful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the wonder and awe inspired by God.
data.etymology: Miranda belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Admirable, wonderful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Miranda total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
